summary.text: Jeffrey Ostler is the Constitution Party candidate for the Utah State Senate, District 7, in the November 3, 2026 general election, an open seat also contested by Democrat Garret Rushforth and Republican Stephanie Hollist.
He was also the Constitution Party candidate for Utah State Auditor in 2020 and 2024.

paragraphs.text: Ostler ran for Utah State Auditor as a Constitution Party candidate in 2020, losing the general election to incumbent John Dougall.
He ran for the same office again in 2024, when Tina Cannon won the general election.
